create_backbone_subclass: create a subclass of Backbone that implements forward to return a dict of feature name to tensor
implement_backbone_forward: implement the forward method in a Backbone subclass to return feature maps as a dict of tensors
override_size_divisibility: override the size_divisibility property in a Backbone subclass to require specific input dimensions
use_output_shape: use the output_shape method to get a dict mapping feature names to ShapeSpec with channels and stride
review_backbone_class: review the Backbone abstract base class and its forward method contract for feature map output
